data.name: Demonic Familiar
data.description: The demonic apostle gains a familiar as a wizard equal to her cleric level, or if she already has a familiar, her cleric levels stack to determine the familiar's abilities. At 3rd level, her familiar gains the fiendish template (Bestiary 294). At 7th level, the demonic apostle exchanges her familiar for a quasit without the need to take the Improved Familiar feat.
